test_title: PYST 197: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23rd Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Vishal is the husband of Narmada. Pratik is the brother of Gaurvi. Kartik is the son of Prathmesh, who is the husband of Arti. Arti's son is married to Narmada. Gaurvi is the daughter of Vishal. How is Prathmesh related to Gaurvi?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given:

1) Kartik is the son of __**Prathmesh, who**__ is the husband of Arti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa47f90883272f94eee76ffbeb5461fed596d1cd189ba6f63e3b600a1916628.png] 

2) Arti's son is married to Narmada.

3) Vishal is the husband of Narmada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c6cace7964b9b98cdbf84fa1a1d93748f279aaa4bd1ce60b8276c237618034f.png] 

4) Gaurvi is the daughter of Vishal.

5) Pratik is the brother of Gaurvi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/201df536a4c27e709dfa64350a645b36b689e97258d4bd3886417d29cec96fe8.png] 

Clearly, Prathmesh is the "Paternal grandfather" of Gaurvi.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Paternal Grandfather".**
